latest_release.name: v2.5.2
latest_release.body: 🎉 Welcome to the v2.5.2 release of the kgateway project! --- ## Release Notes ### Changes since v2.5.1 #### Bug Fixes * TrafficPolicy now accepts `retry.perTryTimeout` together with `timeouts.request: 0s` (timeout disabled), and a per-try timeout equal to the request timeout, matching HTTPRoute. ([#15038](https://github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/pull/15038)) #### Dependency Updates * Bump Go to 1.27.4 to address CVE-2026-97054, and bump rustix to 1.1.6 to address RUSTSEC-2026-0486. ([#15031](https://github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/pull/15031)) ## Contributors Thanks to all the contributors who made this release possible: ## Installation The kgateway project is available as a Helm chart and docker images. ### Helm Charts The Helm charts are available at: - oci://cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/charts/kgateway - oci://cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/charts/kgateway-crds ### Docker Images The docker images are available at: - cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/kgateway:v2.5.2 - cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/sds:v2.5.2 - cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/envoy-wrapper:v2.5.2 ## Quickstart Try installing this release: ``` helm install kgateway-crds oci://cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/charts/kgateway-crds --version v2.5.2 --namespace kgateway-system --create-namespace helm install kgateway oci://cr.kgateway.dev/kgateway-dev/charts/kgateway --version v2.5.2 --namespace kgateway-system --create-namespace ``` For detailed installation instructions and next steps, please visit our [quickstart guide](https://kgateway.dev/docs/quickstart/).
